address_extension.meaning: Nine zero sentinels; private owner SRAM is not externally addressed

window: 1 <= count <= 128 and base + count <= M. Full allocations and permissions are validated before active windows. All input constants are readonly before launch; outputs and guards begin as sentinels.
publication: Matching successful owner completion, exact acknowledged D bytes, and accepted Host completion publish the active D span. No output may publish before final write ACK or completion acceptance.
fan_out: One authentic layer3 input RMSNorm producer 07 supplies Q, K and V. Events 0->1->2->3 sequence commands, not tensor dependencies. Distinct official Wq/Wk/Wv and physical D allocations; verify all earlier outputs after each command and at finish.
reference: Sequential K=0..1023 FP32 std::fma, then terminal BF16 RNE. Optional code-pinned independent integer/C terminal receipts require exact raw A and K-major W hashes. Native producer 08 compares Q content and gate separately; producers 17/26 compare K/V, each max_abs<=0.03125 and mean_abs<=0.005. Preserve full native audit failures.
compatibility: The bf16V profile and all existing Host FP32/default operations remain separate. Policy version 1, private commands, arbitrary NPZ inputs, and caller-supplied trusted digests are not admitted.
